title: Envoy static bootstrap smoke: prefix_rewrite, exact path, direct_response deny, virtual-host scoping
claims: route prefix /api/ with prefix_rewrite /v1/ forwards /api/x?q=1 to backend a as /v1/x?q=1
route path /status forwards exactly /status to backend b
a sub-path of the exact route is not forwarded
a direct_response 403 route answers 403 for its prefix without reaching a backend
a request for a Host outside the virtual host's domains is not forwarded
an unrouted path is not forwarded

source_semantics: Envoy v3 HCM: routes are evaluated in order within the virtual host selected by domains; prefix_rewrite replaces the matched prefix; path matches exactly; direct_response answers without an upstream; no virtual host or route match answers 404.
